reader.requirement: At --std 85, after a report footing is presented LINE-COUNTER holds the line number of its final print line (paged or unpaged, single or multi-line, on its own page or not), and a nonprintable report footing leaves LINE-COUNTER unchanged.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup (LINE-COUNTER restore of a discarded save, latest editions only); the RF's own LINE-COUNTER setting in PresentLine is edition-free

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehaviors.IsActive|Edition in ReportWriter.cs; PresentLine sets LineCounter = target for every printed line with no edition test, and BeginGroup's nonprintable return path touches no counter.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f29_03 covers an unpaged two-line footing (LC 4) and a nonprintable one (LC 2); not exercised: paged footings, a footing on its own page, a nonprintable footing after a page footing

probes.expected: 4a: final print line 19, 20, 4 (on the new page), 6; 4b: nonprintable RF leaves the page footing's final setting 18

probes.printed: R1 LC 04 / RF2 USE LC 02 / R2 LC 02 / LINE 01 [D1] / LINE 03 [RF-A] / LINE 04 [RF-B] (MATCH)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.10 GR4  (3.10.10 Report Footing Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: PresentLine sets LineCounter to each line's target before composing it, so after the last line LINE-COUNTER is the final print line; TerminateCore does not reset it and the value is read after TERMINATE. A report footing with no LINE clause makes BeginGroup return false after its USE procedure, so nothing moves LINE-COUNTER.

refuter.evidence: LINE-COUNTER after TERMINATE: RF whose last line is LINE PLUS 0 (overprint, §1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR4) -> 15, the shared final line (r4rw R-A); RF after a nonprintable PF -> 16; RF on page 2 of a multi-page report -> 18; NP RF on its own page -> 5 (r4rw R-B, R-C, R-F); RF after a PF NEXT GROUP -> 18 and 19 (r4pfng R-M, R-N); a NONPRINTABLE RF after a PF with NEXT GROUP 17 leaves 17, the PF's final setting (r4pfng R-O, rule 4b); NP RF after a saved CF FINAL NEXT GROUP -> 04 (r4save R-S). cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.10.10 GR4 the text is in GR4; OK §1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR4 the text is in GR4.
